test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 05 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

The concert was filled with __rapt __teenage listeners.
solution:
The correct answer is **'fully attentive'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The most appropriate option to substitute "**rapt**" in the given sentence is:*** fully attentive.***
 
• "**Rapt**" in this ***context means deeply engrossed or absorbed in something.***
 
• When someone is "**rapt**" in **a concert, **it implies that they are** fully attentive, focused, and deeply engaged in the music or performance.**
 
• **Option 4, "fully attentive," **captures this meaning accurately. The other options do not convey the same sense of being deeply engaged or absorbed in the concert.
